title: TraceRecover — Self-Healing LLM Agent Reliability
subtitle: Plan -> Execute -> Recover -> Verify -> Decide (100 tasks · 300 paired runs · 0% hallucination)

nodes.label: User Task
nodes.description: Incoming user query or multi-step benchmark task requiring external tool calls.

nodes.label: Plan
nodes.description: Decomposes the task into structured ReAct tool invocations with expected schemas.

nodes.label: Execute
nodes.description: Invokes external tools and logs granular JSONL execution traces for every step.

nodes.label: Fault Injection
nodes.description: Configurable fault harness injecting timeout, wrong-output, empty-result, and bad-argument failures.

nodes.label: Verify
nodes.description: Evidence-grounded NLI verifier & uncertainty taxonomy check before answering.

nodes.label: Recover Loop
nodes.description: Localizes tool failure and triggers targeted evidence-grounded retry or fallback tool call.

nodes.label: Decide (ANSWER / WARN / ABSTAIN)
nodes.description: Calibration gate emitting grounded ANSWER, uncertainty WARN, or safe ABSTAIN (0% hallucination).
